_comment: The symbols the card EXPECTS to see. This list exists so a symbol that
stops reporting entirely shows up as MISSING instead of just quietly
vanishing off the page - which is exactly the bug that shipped in v1.
JUNE: adding symbols is cheap in code and expensive in attention. Three
equities is already more than one person can honestly track daily. If you
add more, expect the extra calls to be worse, not better - you'll be
spending the same judgment across more surface.
